package.name: garudanex_bridge
package.description: PX4 to ROS 2 coordinate frame and message bridges for GarudaNEX. Converts PX4 NED/FRD state estimates to REP-103 ENU/FLU, publishes nav_msgs/Odometry and the odom-to-base_link transform, and translates Nav2 velocity commands into PX4 offboard trajectory setpoints.
